title: Report the statements
instructions: Write the whole sentence in **reported speech**. You report the sentences **a few days later**. The beginning is already there. Remember: backshift, pronouns, time and place.

items.answer: Diego said (that) he had finished his homework.
items.hint: present perfect → past perfect, my → his

items.direct: Aisha to Mila: "I'm going to join the school band."
items.answer: Aisha told Mila (that) she was going to join the school band.
items.hint: am going to → was going to

items.direct: Tyler: "I saw a great film on Saturday."
items.answer: Tyler said (that) he had seen a great film on Saturday.

items.direct: Mrs Moreno: "Dinner will be ready in ten minutes."
items.answer: Mrs Moreno said (that) dinner would be ready in ten minutes.

items.direct: Sofia to Mila: "You can borrow my jacket."
items.answer: Sofia told Mila (that) she could borrow her jacket.
items.hint: you → she (Mila), can → could, my → her (Sofia's jacket)

items.direct: Mr Okafor: "The library is closed today."
items.answer: Mr Okafor said (that) the library was closed that day.

items.direct: Diego: "We are practising for the big game."
items.answer: Diego said (that) they were practising for the big game.
items.hint: we → they, are practising → were practising

items.answer: Mila said (that) her parents had called her [the day before|the previous day].
items.hint: my → her, me → her, called → had called, yesterday → the day before

items.direct: Coach Brooks to the team: "You must be at the field at seven o'clock tomorrow."
items.answer: Coach Brooks told the team (that) they had to be at the field at seven o'clock [the next day|the following day].
items.hint: you → they, must → had to, tomorrow → the next day
